'''Travis Winters''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Iowa State Championship]] on 18 March 2000 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to Seth Van Winkle's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d402">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-27-iowa-state-championships-3-18d402/ iowa-state-championships-3-18], DeckTech (Seth "Ooryl" Van Winkle, 27 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-27-iowa-state-championships-3-18d402/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
